moments.title: I'm A Celeb Kicks Off Tonight!
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! begins tonight at 9pm on ITV1, with Ant & Dec returning to host from Australia.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: It's officially jungle time! I'm A Celebrity… Get Me Out Of Here! returns to our screens tonight, Monday 16 November 2026, with 11 new campmates ready to face those Bushtucker Trials. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Line-Up Tease
angles.copy: Former England footballer Wayne Rooney, Gavin & Stacey actress Joanna Page, and Kaiser Chiefs frontman Ricky Wilson are among the stars heading into the I'm A Celeb jungle tonight!

angles.name: Welsh Local Angle
angles.copy: Our very own Joanna Page from Gavin & Stacey is heading into the I'm A Celeb jungle tonight! Will you be tuning in to support the Welsh star?

moments.title: England Stun Spain in Nations League
moments.blurb: England defeated world champions Spain 3-2 in Madrid yesterday, ending La Roja's 43-game unbeaten run and securing top spot in their UEFA Nations League group.

angles.name: Match Recap
angles.copy: What a win! England beat Spain 3-2 in Madrid yesterday, ending their incredible 43-game unbeaten streak. Top of the Nations League group for the Three Lions!

angles.name: Heroics
angles.copy: 10-man England held on for a stunning 3-2 victory over Spain in Madrid, with James Trafford making crucial saves in stoppage time. What a performance!

moments.title: Strictly Heads to Blackpool!
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is heading to the iconic Blackpool Tower Ballroom this Saturday, November 21st, after Will Best and Dianne Buswell were eliminated yesterday.

angles.name: Blackpool Excitement
angles.copy: The glitterball trophy feels closer than ever as Strictly Come Dancing heads to Blackpool Tower Ballroom this Saturday! Who are you hoping shines brightest on the iconic dancefloor?

angles.name: Elimination Talk
angles.copy: Gutted for Will Best and Dianne Buswell, eliminated just before Blackpool! Who do you think will be the one to watch next weekend?

moments.title: Massive Premier League Clash: Liverpool vs Man Utd
moments.blurb: The Premier League serves up a huge rivalry game this Sunday, November 22nd, as Liverpool host Manchester United at Anfield.

angles.name: Build-up
angles.copy: Anfield awaits a colossal Premier League clash this Sunday! Liverpool vs Manchester United – who's taking the bragging rights in this fierce rivalry?

angles.name: Predictions
angles.copy: Liverpool vs Man Utd this Sunday! What's your score prediction for one of English football's biggest games?

moments.title: Title Showdown: Arsenal vs Man City
moments.blurb: A potential title-deciding Premier League fixture takes place on Sunday, November 29th, as Arsenal host Manchester City at the Emirates Stadium.

angles.name: Early Buzz
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! Arsenal vs Manchester City on November 29th is shaping up to be a monumental Premier League battle. Who's got the edge?

angles.name: Key Game
angles.copy: A huge one for the Premier League title race! Arsenal host Man City on the 29th – can the Gunners make a statement at home?

moments.title: Black Friday is Coming!
moments.blurb: Black Friday officially falls on Friday, November 27th, but many UK retailers are expected to start their deals earlier, with 'Black Week' promotions beginning around November 23rd.

angles.name: Shopping Prep
angles.copy: Get ready, shoppers! Black Friday is just over a week away (Nov 27th), but deals are expected to start dropping from next Monday. What's on your wishlist?

angles.name: Early Deals
angles.copy: Eyeing a bargain? Black Friday sales could kick off as early as next week! Keep an eye out for those early bird discounts.

moments.title: Cardiff Christmas Market Open
moments.blurb: The Cardiff Christmas Market opened on November 12th and runs daily until December 23rd, featuring over 200 stalls across the city centre.

angles.name: Market Vibes
angles.copy: Cardiff is officially festive! The Christmas Market is open daily, bringing handcrafted gifts, local treats, and mulled wine to the city centre until December 23rd.

angles.name: Local Craft Focus
angles.copy: Support local this Christmas! Cardiff Christmas Market is packed with Welsh artisan crafts, unique gifts, and delicious food. What's your favourite stall?

moments.title: Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market Underway
moments.blurb: The Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market opened on November 13th and transforms Cathedral Green into a festive shopping destination until December 13th.

angles.name: Market Magic
angles.copy: Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market is in full swing! Explore over 100 festive traders, delicious food, and a brand-new tipi bar on Cathedral Green until Dec 13th.

angles.name: Devon Delights
angles.copy: Wander through twinkling chalets and find the best of Devon and beyond at the Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market, open now! What's your top tip for visitors?

moments.title: Jamie Miller Still No.1 on UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' holds the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for an 11th week, while Queens of the Stone Age's 'Perfecth' is the new No.1 album.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' is Number 1 on the UK Singles Chart for an incredible 11th week! Listen now on Nation Hits.

angles.name: Album & Festive Entries
angles.copy: Queens of the Stone Age land the new No.1 album with 'Perfecth'! Meanwhile, Christmas classics like Mariah Carey and Wham! are already climbing the singles chart.

moments.title: Happy 79th Birthday, Mick Box!
moments.blurb: Mick Box, legendary guitarist and only constant member of rock band Uriah Heep, turns 79 today. He was born on November 16, 1947.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 79th birthday to rock icon Mick Box, the incredible guitarist from Uriah Heep! Still rocking hard after all these years. #UriahHeep

angles.name: R&B Icon

moments.title: Happy 64th Birthday, Kirk Hammett!

moments.title: Happy 61st Birthday, Björk!

moments.blurb: Global superstar Miley Cyrus, known for hits like 'Wrecking Ball' and 'Flowers', celebrates her 34th birthday on November 23rd. She was born in 1992.

angles.name: Pop Star

moments.title: Happy 41st Birthday, Ben Haenow!
